name: A-aturseva-ref
prompt: Below are 8 numbered screenshots (call them A1 through A8, in the order provided) taken from the owners phone, all related to Aturseva — an Indian healthcare booking platform (website + Android app). For EACH screenshot, report precisely: (1) what surface it shows (website landing page / website section / mobile app screen / brand asset), (2) the EXACT logo/brandmark visible: describe its symbol shape, colors, and any wordmark text you can read (spell it letter by letter if partially visible), (3) the dominant secondary/accent colors visible (describe the hue precisely and give approximate hex, e.g. bright aqua #00BAA7), (4) notable UI elements (hero, cards, doctor photos, buttons, illustrations). This is a branding + design reference audit: the owner says THIS is the correct Aturseva branding and color direction. Be concrete and honest; do not guess beyond what is visible.
verdict:
# Aturseva Branding & Design Reference Audit

## A1 — Splash / Loading Screen (Mobile App)
1. **Surface:** Android app loading/splash state, Home screen while content is loading (skeleton placeholders fading in behind the brandmark).
2. **Logo/brandmark:** The only true logo asset in the set — a **teardrop/droplet symbol**: a solid deep-teal drop shape (outer drop ~#177E75) containing a lighter aqua inner drop (~#2FA9A0), sitting above a thick **black curved smile/arc** stroke (like a smile cradle under the drop). No wordmark is attached to the symbol in this render; app name appears as plain text "Aturseva v0.3.0" below.
3. **Accent colors:** Deep teal (~#177E75), lighter aqua (~#2FA9A0), black (~#111111), near-white background (#FAFAFA), grey skeleton placeholders (#EDEDED).
4. **UI elements:** Search bar placeholder "Doctor name or problem — fever, knee p...", chip row (fever, knee pain, skin, child, ac...), "Doctors ● live" heading with mint-green live badge (~#DFF4F0 pill), skeleton doctor card, footer "Privacy · Terms", bottom nav Home/Bookings/Profile.

## A2 — Home Screen, Loaded (Mobile App)
1. **Surface:** Mobile app home screen (Aturseva v0.3.0).
2. **Logo:** **None visible** — no logo/wordmark on the home screen; branding only via footer text "Aturseva v0.3.0" and the teal live-status dot.
3. **Accents:** Teal status dot & "live" badge (~#1A8F85 on mint #DDF3EF); everything else black/grey/off-white. Primary palette is essentially black-on-off-white (#111 text, #F5F5F4 chips/cards).
4. **UI:** Search bar, quick-filter chips (fever, knee pain, skin, child), live stats line "97 doctors · 13 hospitals · 69 visits booked — live", **Doctors** carousel cards (avatar circles with initials "R", no doctor photos — letter avatars), ₹300 visit price, **Hospitals** section with "See all" pill, CIIMS Hospital card (CH initials), "Select city · change", bottom nav with Home active.

## A3 — Doctor Detail Screen (Mobile App)
1. **Surface:** Mobile app doctor profile page.
2. **Logo:** None.
3. **Accents:** Monochrome design — off-white fee card (#F2F2F0), **black pill CTA** "Book appointment — ₹300" (pure black #0A0A0A, white text). No teal here.
4. **UI:** "DR" initial avatar (no photo), fee block "₹300 first visit / Pay at the clinic — no advance payment.", Clinic hours card (Mon–Sat 09:00–17:00, Sunday Closed), "17 visits · 4 patients on Aturseva", Practices at (Rajesh Clinic, CIIMS Hospital), sticky black bottom CTA.

## A4 — Doctor Detail, Scrolled (Mobile App)
1. **Surface:** Same doctor profile, scrolled to bottom.
2. **Logo:** None.
3. **Accents:** Same monochrome system; grey chevrons, off-white "Share on WhatsApp" button, black CTA.
4. **UI:** Practices card, **Similar doctors** list (Dr. Ref One ₹500, Dr. Prod Final ₹400, Dr. Pack Test ₹400 — all initial avatars DR/DP, no photos), "Share on WhatsApp" pill, "Book appointment — ₹300" black pill.

## A5 — Slot Picker Bottom Sheet (Mobile App)
1. **Surface:** Bottom-sheet modal over the doctor screen for time-slot selection.
2. **Logo:** None.
3. **Accents:** Monochrome — selected state is **black pill** ("Tomorrow"), unselected chips off-white; disabled "Confirm slot" button grey (#9C9C9C).
4. **UI:** Drag handle, doctor summary row, date chips (Today / Tomorrow / 11/24 / 11/25), MORNING/AFTERNOON/EVENING grouped 15-min slot grid, capacity line "32 slots open · 0 booked today · limit 50", footer "₹300 · pay at the clinic — Pick a time to continue".

## A6 — Confirm Appointment (Mobile App)
1. **Surface:** Mobile app booking-confirmation form screen.
2. **Logo:** None.
3. **Accents:** Monochrome; black "Confirm booking · ₹300" pill CTA; off-white summary/fee cards.
4. **UI:** Back pill, summary card (Visit Tomorrow · 09:15, Mode In person at the clinic, Fee ₹300), form fields (Full name, 10-digit Indian mobile, Reason for the visit) with rounded outline inputs, helper text "Your token and booking updates travel to this number.", fee card "No advance payment. Free cancellation from this app."

## A7 — Booking Status / Token Screen (Mobile App)
1. **Surface:** Mobile app booking-status screen ("Your booking", #JLUNSQ).
2. **Logo:** None.
3. **Accents:** **Teal returns here** — "Request sent" label and status dot in teal (~#177E75), filled teal checkmark in the progress stepper; off-white hero card; black "Track queue" CTA.
4. **UI:** Status hero "Token being assigned" with auto-update explainer, 3-step progress (Booked ✓ → Confirmed → Completed), detail card (Doctor/Clinic/Date/Time/Fee/City/Patient/Reason), black "Track queue", off-white "Share token", "Book again with this doctor" chip.

## A8 — Queue Tracking Screen (Mobile App)
1. **Surface:** Mobile app live queue screen ("Your turn").
2. **Logo:** None.
3. **Accents:** Teal status dot + teal "Waiting for confirmation" label (~#177E75); otherwise black/off-white; grey "Refresh now" pill.
4. **UI:** Status hero "Not in the line yet", doctor card (Dr. Rajesh · Rajesh Clinic · Gandhinagar · Booking #JLUNSQ), "Updated 1:22 pm · refreshes automatically", Refresh now button.

---

## Honest Summary for Branding Direction
- **Only logo asset found:** A1's droplet-over-smile symbol — deep teal drop (#177E75) with lighter aqua inner drop (#2FA9A0) on a black arc. No wordmark locked to the symbol anywhere in these 8 screenshots; "Aturseva" appears only as plain grey body text (A1, A2 footer, A3 "on Aturseva").
- **App color system:** Predominantly **black-on-off-white** (#111 text, #F5F5F4 cards/chips) with **teal/aqua (~#177E75 / #2FA9A0)** used sparingly for live/status indicators (live badges, status dots, progress check) and in the logo. Primary CTAs are solid black pills, not teal.
- **No doctor photos anywhere** — all avatars are neutral letter-initial circles (R, CH, QB, DR, DP).
- **No website screens** in this set; all 8 are Android app surfaces (A1–A8 all mobile app). I cannot confirm website branding from these images.
